house_of_hope.about: Act 3, the House of Hope room where Raphael's final battle takes place (the same level as the Lower City and the Undercity, no level change), door closed and every NPC moved out, reached by engine teleport in a test save. The test save keeps the boss standing at the enemy spot in its own faction (neutral): the popup's Start moves it back, forces its stats again (they do not survive a reload) and makes it hostile. The rest of the party is parked in the Undercity, far from the room.
house_of_hope.leave_spots_about: Spots for the evade tactic's move (Disengage, move more than 3 m from the boss and out of its reach, shoot): [x, y, z] each, surveyed in game; the plan's move step (@leave_spot) takes the one nearest the character at least 4.5 m from the boss. Empty: the harness finds one by path around the boss.
house_of_hope.hide_spots_about: Spots out of the boss's sight for a Hide (@hide_spot), surveyed in game; empty: a planned Hide's move fails and the run shows it. The room is lit, so the model plans no Hide here.

undercity_cistern.about: Act 3, Lower City level, Undercity Ruins / Abandoned Cistern. Surveyed by engine: ground 10-18 m (a 5 m ledge east of the start), caustic brine and water puddles that are part of the level, no living NPC within 30 m in a save where the Undercity Ruins fights are over. Chasm edge at z < 857: every spot stays north of it.

undercity_north.about: Act 3, Lower City level: the second lane, 72 m north-east of undercity_cistern (centre to centre), the spot where a two-combat probe ran its second fight (a character there and an enemy 4 m east formed their own combat). Same layout as undercity_cistern: start, then the enemies along +x. Survey (one game run): ground fine; two living NPCs stand at the start (about -157,939 and -157,941), moved away for a lanes' run (undercity_lanes npc_park). Surveyed again with them moved: no one inside, ground fine at the start and the enemy spot; a lane run across two pairs (lane A undercity_cistern) ran both lanes to the end, valid, with no hits across lanes.

undercity_lanes.about: Two fights at once: lane A in undercity_cistern, lane B in undercity_north, both facing +x (mirrored side by side, every spell aimed away from the other lane). Each lane's enemies get their own faction (factions with no member in the world), set hostile to that lane's character and neutral to the other lane; when the two characters share a faction, each gets its lane's character faction for the run. The rest of the party is parked at the grease-floored clearing far west (no NPC there in the survey), out of combat. Living characters outside the party within a lane's radius + margin (lane B's start had two in a survey) are moved by engine to npc_park (the same clearing, far from both lanes) for the run and put back after the last lane.
